description: This file contains utility functions for handling URL redirection, including generating return URLs, normalizing parameters, and extracting redirect info from HTTP requests, primarily used in authentication flows.

methods.name: getReturnTo
methods.description: Verifies encrypted parameters with JWT and returns a normalized redirect URL, defaulting to the home location if verification fails.

methods.name: normalizeParams
methods.description: Ensures redirect parameters are valid, defaulting to home location and allowed origins if invalid.

methods.name: getPrefixedLandingPath
methods.description: Constructs a landing path with optional language prefix.

methods.name: getParamsFromUrl
methods.description: Parses a URL to extract origin and path prefix, then normalizes parameters.

methods.name: getRedirectParams
methods.description: Extracts redirect parameters from request headers.

methods.name: getLoginRedirectParams
methods.description: Extracts redirect parameters from signed cookies after login.

methods.name: haveSamePath
methods.description: Checks if two URLs have the same pathname.
